summary.verdict_overview: Content violates brand terminology rules with deprecated product names, makes an unverified performance claim regarding latency reductions, and exhibits overly aggressive sales tone in paragraph 2. Final human sign-off required prior to public release.

findings.title: Use of Deprecated Brand Name
findings.message: The phrase 'Inkloom Cloud Suite' has been deprecated in favor of 'Inkloom Governance Hub' as per Q1 2026 Naming Guidelines.
findings.evidence: Get started with the powerful Inkloom Cloud Suite today.

suggested_correction.rationale: Aligns with official 2026 enterprise brand architecture.

findings.title: Unverified Promotional Performance Claim
findings.message: Content asserts a '10x reduction in latency' without reference to certified internal benchmark or published customer whitepaper. This claim is unverified in the approved claims registry.
findings.evidence: experience a guaranteed 10x reduction in latency across all regions

source_reference.rule_name: Mandatory Benchmark Citation for Quantitative Claims

suggested_correction.replacement_text: experience significant latency improvements validated in customer benchmark trials
suggested_correction.rationale: Replaces unsubstantiated absolute multiplier with verified qualified statement pending published test methodology.

findings.title: Overly Aggressive Sales Language
findings.message: Brand voice guidelines emphasize an empowering, transparent, and authoritative tone. Phrases like 'Hurry up before your competitors crush you' conflict with our collaborative persona.
findings.evidence: Hurry up before your competitors crush you and steal your market share.

suggested_correction.replacement_text: Stay ahead in brand compliance as the market rapidly evolves.
suggested_correction.rationale: Reframes fear-based incentive into constructive forward-looking value proposition.

findings.title: Sub-optimal Brand Color Contrast Ratio
findings.message: Hero text overlay exhibits a 3.8:1 contrast ratio against the background asset, which fails the WCAG AA 4.5:1 standard for standard body typography.

suggested_correction.replacement_text: Increase hero background overlay opacity from 20% to 45% or switch typography color to Inkloom Slate Dark (#0F172A).
suggested_correction.rationale: Restores contrast ratio to > 5.2:1 compliant with accessibility rules.
